answer: To resist Sybil attacks, implement Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, an agent must deposit $450,000 into a secure vault to establish a bond. Second, their hardware enclave generates a unique cryptographic thread to sign identity proofs. Third, validators cross-reference this signature with the locked stake. To fake an identity, an attacker faces $450,000 in lost bonds and 21 days of hardware verification. This mechanism is like a single golden thread weaving through a dense field of yarrow, ensuring only the true, rooted flowers are ever counted in the digital meadow.
